claims: As of April 12, 2026, Tyson Fury's professional boxing record is 34-2-1 (24 KOs).
Tyson Fury is a British heavyweight.
Tyson Fury is known as "The Gypsy King".
Tyson Fury is a former lineal and WBC champion.
Tyson Fury fought Arslanbek Makhmudov on April 11, 2026.
Tyson Fury has 24 wins by knockout.
Tyson Fury has a total of 38 fights.
Tyson Fury was WBC Heavyweight Champion from 2020 to 2024.
Tyson Fury defeated Wladimir Klitschko in 2015.
Tyson Fury defeated Dillian Whyte in 2022.
Tyson Fury won a trilogy against Derek Chisora.
Tyson Fury has two wins and one draw against Deontay Wilder.
Tyson Fury has losses to Oleksandr Usyk.
